items.title: Albert Murray interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 24, 1997
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You’re actually here to talk about William Faulkner this afternoon. [INTERVIEWEE] Right.

ctx.x: It was our pleasure to give you an honorary doctorate in May, and we’re glad to have you back. You’re actually here to talk about William Faulkner this afternoon.
